{{Quote|This thing really moves!|Poe Dameron on the TIE fighter|<ref name="VII" />}}
A '''TIE/sf space superiority fighter''' was used by the [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] and the [[Desertion|deserting]] [[stormtrooper]] [[Finn|FN-2187]] during their [[Escape from the Finalizer|escape]] from the ''[[Finalizer]]''.

==History==
Following the [[Attack on Tuanul]], [[First Order]] stormtrooper [[Finn|FN-2187]] became disillusioned with the First Order. Deciding to rescue the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]], who had been captured during the attack, FN-2187 and Dameron took a [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]] and used it to escape the ''[[Finalizer]]''.<ref name="VII" />
